intro.h2: Plan it in 3D, see it in our showroom
paragraphs: The Expert Touch handles home remodeling in Toms River from a real showroom at 1021 Route 37, where the sign out front says it plainly: kitchens and bathrooms. You start with a free estimate and 3D drawings, so you can see your new room before any demolition begins.

Bathroom renovations come up most in the reviews, followed by kitchen remodels and the friendly crew. One customer had her mom's bathroom remodeled and says the showroom was super helpful, the prices competitive and the workers on time and respectful. Even the family dog liked them. Another found the team to be great listeners when it came to what they wanted, from design to the finishing touches.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Full kitchen remodels planned with 3D drawings: new layout, cabinets, countertops, backsplash, lighting and floors. The kitchens in the photos include a navy island with a dark stone top and a black farmhouse sink, and a white shaker kitchen with swirled stone counters.

image.alt: Kitchen with a long navy island, dark stone countertop, white cabinets and three glass pendant lights

items.name: Bathroom renovations
items.blurb: The job customers mention most often. Walk-in showers and tub surrounds with large-format tile, mosaic accent bands and built-in niches, plus new vanities and tops, all chosen with help from the showroom and planned in 3D before work starts.

image.alt: Shower with large gray wall tile, hexagon mosaic band, two recessed niches and glass door

items.name: Custom cabinets
items.blurb: Cabinets that make use of every wall, from tall pantry towers around the refrigerator to glass-front uppers and open shelves. Look at door styles and finishes in the showroom, then see how they fit your room in the 3D drawing.

image.alt: Tall white shaker pantry cabinets with brushed nickel pulls in a hallway

items.name: Countertops and backsplashes
items.blurb: Stone countertops with bold veining or a quiet dark matte finish, paired with subway tile or mosaic backsplashes. The same choices carry into bathrooms too, like the vanity top in black and white swirled stone shown in the gallery below.

image.alt: White kitchen with gray and white granite countertops, stainless appliances and mosaic backsplash

items.name: Flooring and home improvements
items.blurb: New floors that tie the rooms together, plus general home repairs and improvements. The photos also include new entry doors with decorative leaded glass, a quick way to change how a house greets you before guests even step inside.

image.alt: White double entry doors with tall decorative leaded glass inserts

about.text: The Expert Touch, also known as Total Home Improvements, is a remodeling company with a showroom at 1021 NJ-37, Unit D, in Toms River, New Jersey. It specializes in custom home renovations, mostly kitchens and bathrooms, and offers free estimates with 3D drawings. Customers often mention Don and Andrew, who they say make everything easy from design to the finishing touches and are always a phone call away. With a 5.0 rating from 33 Google reviews, the team is known for being friendly, punctual and respectful, and one reviewer sums it up: they truly care about their work and the customer.

image.alt: The Expert Touch storefront on Route 37 in Toms River, with a sign for home remodeling and repairs, kitchens and bathrooms

items.name: Erica M.
items.text:
I cannot say enough great things about The Expert Touch! From start to finish, they were incredibly professional, communicative, and reliable. They showed up exactly when they said they would, kept me informed throughout the entire process, and completed all of the work as promised.

Not only was their work top-notch, but they were also courteous, flexible, and genuinely helpful every step of the way. They took the time to answer questions, made sure everything met our expectations, and went above and beyond to ensure we were happy.

One thing that really stood out was how clean and respectful they were—everything was left spotless when the job was done, which made such a difference.

If you’re looking for a company that is dependable, detail-oriented, and truly cares about their customers, The Expert Touch is it. I would absolutely recommend them and will be using them again in the future!

items.name: Danielle M.
items.text: Recently finished a bathroom remodel for my mom. I cannot say enough how great they were to work with.  They return phone calls, the workers show up on time and they always cleaned up before they left. Very respectful of my mom and my dog even liked them.  The showroom was super helpful for my mom and the prices  are competitive. Great bunch of guys!

items.name: Marie M.
items.text: We had the pleasure of working with the staff at Expert Touch.  Don and Andrew make everything so easy from design to the finishing touches.  They were knowledgeable, friendly, great listeners when it came to what we wanted, punctual and always a phone call away if we had any questions.  I highly recommend Expert Touch, I wouldn't use anyone else.

service_area.h2: Home remodeling in Toms River, NJ
service_area.text: The Expert Touch works from its showroom at 1021 NJ-37, Unit D, in Toms River, New Jersey. Homeowners in Toms River and the surrounding area visit the showroom to pick materials and plan their kitchens and bathrooms. If you live nearby and want to know whether your town is covered, call (732) 820-6720 on a weekday between 8 AM and 4 PM.

items.a: Yes. The Expert Touch offers free estimates, and they come with 3D drawings of your project so you can see the layout and finishes before you decide. Call (732) 820-6720 or email info@theexperttouchllc.com to set up a time that works for you.

Yes. Our showroom is at 1021 NJ-37, Unit D, Toms River, NJ 08755, and it is open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 4 PM. Stop by to look at cabinets, countertops and tile, or call (732) 820-6720 first to set a time.

Yes. The Expert Touch's Instagram profile includes a link for financing. Ask about it during your free estimate and the team can walk you through what is available, so the cost of a kitchen or bathroom remodel does not have to stop you from planning it.

items.q: Do you do both kitchens and bathrooms?
items.a: Yes. Kitchens and bathrooms are the core of the business, and the reviews mention bathroom renovations more than anything else, followed by kitchen remodels. We also handle custom cabinets, countertops, backsplashes, flooring and the general home repairs and improvements listed on the sign outside our showroom.

Customers often mention Don and Andrew, who they say make everything easy from design to the finishing touches and are always a phone call away. Reviewers also describe a friendly crew that shows up on time, returns calls and cleans up before leaving each day.
